title: Neon Pulse (Cyberpunk Etude)
director_summary: A high-voltage synthwave choreography on a rain-slicked holographic rooftop. Kaelen Vex locks into the 16th-note arpeggio intro with mechanical precision, builds kinetic charge through the accelerating snare riser (8.0s–16.0s), and unleashes full-stage shockwave leaps during the sub-bass drop at 16.0s before powering down into the ambient neon rain.

character.name: Kaelen Vex, the Neon Cyber-Dancer
character.concept: An agile android street-performer clad in electroluminescent armor and a holographic visor that displays real-time audio waveforms.
character.style: High-contrast cyberpunk vector anime with glowing neon edge-lighting and chromatic aberration pulses

sections.name: Arpeggio Boot-Sequence
sections.background: Dark cyberpunk rooftop with distant magenta billboards and slow-scrolling wireframe grid

sections.name: Overclock Snare Riser
sections.background: Grid lines accelerate upward as cyan lightning arcs across the sky

sections.name: High-Voltage Drop
sections.background: Full holographic city illumination with bass-reactive shockwave rings

sections.name: System Cooldown
sections.background: Dimming neon signage with gentle digital rain reflections

events.why: Kaelen's visor ignites and he locks into a crisp robotic knee-bounce as the 129 BPM synth arpeggio establishes the groove.
Sharp lateral slide to the left on the harmonic root change, leaving a cyan plasma afterimage across the grid.
Mirrors the opening phrase with a snappy right-side glide to balance the stage geometry before the percussion enters.
As the crisp quarter-note snare build begins at 9.0s, Kaelen raises both gauntlets to summon a spinning neon charge halo.
The snare doubles its subdivision into a fierce roll; Kaelen executes a high-speed 360-degree vortex spin that pulls aurora sparks inward.
During the blinding 16th-note pitch sweep, Kaelen holds an overcharged power stance as the camera zooms in tightly for the impending drop.
Anti-gravity thrusters fire for a massive vertical leap on the high C6 lead synth accent, shattering the floor grid with a magenta shockwave.
Whips into an electric air-flare spin on the melodic turnaround, scattering twin plasma trails across the lens.
Executes one final apex boost jump as the lead melody hits its closing cadence, maximizing airborne energy before the cutoff.
The drums and sub-bass abruptly cut out at 27.1s; Kaelen freezes in a silhouette crouch as his visor glow slowly dims into the rain.

climax.description: After an 8-second snare and pitch-riser buildup, the full four-on-the-floor kick, gritty sub-bass, and soaring octave synth lead erupt simultaneously.
climax.visual_boost: Magenta-cyan chromatic shockwaves on every beat + 1.3x dynamic camera punch + overdrive plasma trail bloom
